title: Shiraishi An — Waving With A Smile〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Outside a supermarket

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, Dad!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Hm? Just you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
The others are still shopping!
But they should be here soon!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I came back first because I wanted to give you this.
Here!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: A coffee...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, as thanks for agreeing to drive us to the airport!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Haha. Thanks.
In that case, I happily accept.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, it feels like it's been forever since we all rode in a car with you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It really reminds me of how you drove us around to all those venues during our training.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, true.
We went out a few times a week back then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly. Back then, I never could've imagined we'd be in the States someday.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Haha. Neither could I.
So, now that you're here, how has your experience been?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Really fun!
We've gotten to hear so much music right at the epicenter of the street scene!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Also, we got to visit a ton of shops.
Including that cafe by the academy with a stage inside!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Apparently, it's somewhere local music lovers like to hang out. The atmosphere was a little different, but I did sort of feel like I was back at our place.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By the way, Dad, have you been talking to Mom?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah, we're doing our best to stay in touch now that we're living apart like this.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Speaking of her, she's been talking all about you lately.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah, so be sure to let her see your smiling face once you get back to Japan. That's the best souvenir you can give her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, I'll do that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, what else have you been talking about with Mom?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: About our business and how we've been doing. That, and complaints she has about work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right. Mom only ever talks about that stuff with you.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Wait, why are you snickering?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No reason. Don't mind me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Dad hasn't changed at all.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (He even put on an amazing performance during SONIC NOTES.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (He's still who I thought was the coolest person in the world when I was little. No, he sang better than he did back then...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Now I see. This has to be why Mom was able to see him off with a smile when he stepped back onto the stage.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (They must be feeling pretty lonely since they don't get to be together, but...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? You and Uncle Taiga are gonna start singing over in the US as a team?!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's the plan.
But that does mean being away from home...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I guess this means we're rivals now, Dad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That probably made Mom really happy as well. I mean, she loves how cool Dad looks whenever he sings...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Make sure to show Mom just how much you appreciate her for letting you come over to the United States like this, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Haha. I will.
Especially since she told me not to come back home until I've stood on top of the world, so I'm feeling real motivated.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, I have some souvenirs that I need you to take back to her. I'll give them to you a little later.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, got it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I also need to figure out what to get her. And there's so much I wanna talk about...
